file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) console executable, MinGW-w64/GCC 13 built, stripped (external PDB), 10 sections

injection_details.method: NtQueueApcThread user-mode APC injection (Early-Bird style) into a suspended thread; payload staged with NtAllocateVirtualMemory (PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE = 0x3000/0x40) and NtWriteVirtualMemory, then NtAlertResumeThread to trigger execution
injection_details.target_process: its own process (self-injection) - PID obtained from GetCurrentProcessId() at 0x140001bb8
injection_details.target_discovery: CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD=4,0) then Thread32First/Thread32Next walking THREADENTRY32 (dwSize=0x1c); first entry whose th32OwnerProcessID (offset 0xC) equals the target PID is taken, th32ThreadID (offset 0x8) opened with OpenThread(0x12 = THREAD_SUSPEND_RESUME|THREAD_SET_CONTEXT, FALSE, tid) and immediately SuspendThread()'d
injection_details.payload_write: NtWriteVirtualMemory(hProcess, remoteBase, decryptedBuffer, 0x30, &bytesWritten) after NtAllocateVirtualMemory reserved 0x30 bytes RWX in the same process
injection_details.payload_source: 48-byte RC4-encrypted blob at .data 0x140004000, decrypted on the stack before injection
injection_details.process_handle: NtOpenProcess with DesiredAccess 0x42A (PROCESS_CREATE_THREAD|VM_OPERATION|VM_WRITE|QUERY_INFORMATION) and ClientId = target PID

helper_functions.0x1400016f4: open target process, anti-debug check, locate + suspend a thread

encryption_details.algorithm: RC4 (custom-implemented KSA at 0x140001480 and PRGA/XOR keystream at 0x140001573; state = 256-byte S-box + i at +0x100, j at +0x104)
encryption_details.key_storage: Hard-coded plaintext byte array embedded in the .rdata section at VA 0x140005000 (first 16 bytes of .rdata); passed to the KSA with an explicit length of 0x10

decoded_strings.NtOpenProcess / NtClose / NtQueryInforma: plaintext API-name strings at .rdata 0x14000501A-0x140005098, resolved dynamically at runtime
decoded_strings.RC4_encrypted_payload (.data:0x140004000: 8E3D721ED55891C32F46BB79E4118C5A673EA40DF69B2844BD7113A5DC087E329954E16C1A87F0462B985DCF730EA641 -- decrypts with RC4 key 4A8C1FD367E92B05CAFE77339D125E88 into the 48-byte shellcode that is written into RWX memory and executed via the queued APC; plaintext not recoverable with static-only tooling (no cipher execution available)

anti_analysis: Anti-debug: NtQueryInformationProcess(ProcessInformationClass = 7 / ProcessDebugPort) on the opened process handle; if the returned debug port == 0xFFFFFFFF the sample calls NtClose and aborts the injection silently (no output, clean exit)

All sensitive native APIs are resolved at runtime through GetModuleHandleA("ntdll.dll") + GetProcAddress and invoked via function pointers, so no Nt* entries appear in the import table (import-table/IAT-hook evasion)
Payload never exists in plaintext on disk: 48-byte shellcode is RC4-encrypted in .data and only decrypted on the stack immediately before injection (defeats static strings/signature scanning)
Uses only benign-looking KERNEL32 imports (Toolhelp32, OpenThread, SuspendThread, Sleep); no CreateRemoteThread/WriteProcessMemory/LoadLibrary imports
Target thread is suspended before the APC is queued and resumed with NtAlertResumeThread, avoiding a new thread creation event (thread-creation telemetry evasion)
Binary is compiled stripped (symbols/line numbers removed, debug info directed to an external PDB); no exports and no resources
Sleep(500) delay after injection before process exit
